dimensions.notes: handleSubmitClick at EditorPane.tsx:88-95 reads verdict imperatively via useAppStore.getState().lastRuns?.[currentSlug] inside the onClick (not via closure or selector subscription), so a problem switch that updates the store between renders still uses the fresh value at click time. The branch is exhaustive: last && last.verdict === 'Accepted' calls handleRun(true) directly; any other case (Wrong Answer, Time Limit Exceeded, Compile Error, No Expected Cases, or null lastRuns) sets pendingSubmit=true — explicitly satisfying 'treat null lastRuns as needing confirmation' safe-default rather than 'treat as no confirmation needed' failure example. All four non-Accepted verdicts produced by handleRun are caught by the else branch.

Block at EditorPane.tsx:352-382 renders 'Passed {passed ?? 0} / {total ?? 0}' with 0/0 fallback when lastRuns[currentSlug] is unavailable at render time. Cancel calls setPendingSubmit(false) only — does not invoke handleRun. Submit anyway calls handleRun(true); pendingSubmit is cleared in handleRun's finally block (line 269) so the block closes in the same run tick regardless of which branch landed. Both buttons are <button type="button"> elements (keyboard-reachable), disabled={busy} guards against double-submit. Block is rendered as a sibling of editor-foot, not inside a portal. role="alertdialog" + aria-label add basic accessibility above the rubric's minimum.

Two reset paths: useEffect on currentSlug clears pendingSubmit on every problem switch; setPendingSubmit(false) at line 269 sits inside handleRun's finally block, which executes after every branch — happy path, TS compile-error early return, no-runnable alert early return, timeout catch, compile catch, and thrown catch-all. Switching problems mid-confirmation closes the block via the slug useEffect without invoking handleRun, so no accidental submit. The useEffect dependency array [currentSlug] is correct.

Block lives inline in EditorPane's JSX — no createPortal, no overlay div, no new component file, no portal import added. Local useState at line 39 mirrors ManageProvidersModal.tsx:89 pattern. New CSS at globals.css:309-310 adds two rules to the existing stylesheet — no new CSS file, no theme primitive, no bespoke typography. Reuses existing classNames btn, btn-submit, kbd-hint, spacer. Block sits in the same row rhythm as Run Code / Submit.

tsc -b exit 0 (clean). vite build 262ms, all assets produced (clean). sandbox suite 17/17 pass — P2 left the sandbox tests untouched. Full vitest run reports 396 pass / 12 fail; all 12 failures live in category.test.ts, fullStateImport.test.ts, providerAdapters.test.ts, providerRegistry.test.ts, tsCheck.test.ts — none modified by P2, all pre-existing baseline failures. package.json shows no new devDep; @testing-library/react not introduced (per the phase's explicit YAGNI rule). LastRun type at store.ts:31-39 unchanged — verdict read path is read-only against the existing selector.
